assignments.node_id: המחין, הינו נשמתו, באה לתוך אמונה, בבחינת: "חדשים לבקרים", ונתחדשו שם, ונתחזקו מעיפותם
assignments.reason: This node describes the mochin/neshamah entering faith and being renewed — the very process that Package 2 centers on. Its essential nature is the renewal of the intellect/soul (חדוש המחין/חדוש הנשמה), which is the core identity of Package 2. It is the EFFECT side of three eitza edges (from שנה, משא ומתן באמונה, and פשטא אוריתא), but what it IS — the soul's renewal within faith — belongs to the domain of divine intellectual renewal.

This is literally 'renewal of the intellect, i.e. renewal of the soul' — the same concept as חדוש המחין and חדוש הנשמה already in Package 2, stated in slightly different words. Its essential nature IS the renewal of wisdom that comes from the Light of the Face. The Torah states: 'חדוש השכל הינו חדוש הנשמה, הוא על ידי שנה' — sleep produces it, but it IS intellectual/soul renewal.

assignments.node_id: עוסק במשא ומתן כל כך באמונה, כמו רב ספרא, ומקים (תהלים ט"ו): "ודובר אמת בלבבו"
assignments.reason: Though this node includes 'commerce in faith' (Package 1 domain), its essential nature is the specific practice of 'speaking truth in one's heart' (דובר אמת בלבבו) during commerce, like Rav Safra. The Torah states: 'זו הבחינה נעשה חשמ"ל, הינו מלבוש, סביב האמונה' — this behavioral act IS what becomes the chasmal. It is the generative practice of the protective garment. Package 3 already contains 'דובר אמת בלבבו' as a node; this compound concept describes the same essential reality: the truth-speaking practice that creates the chasmal.

assignments.node_id: להמשיך בחינת חשמ"ל מעולם הבינה, להלביש את המלכות, הינו אמונה, שלא יינקו ממנה העכו"ם והארצות שסביבותיה.
assignments.reason: This node describes the function of drawing the chasmal from the world of Binah to clothe and protect faith/Malkhut from the surrounding nations. Its essential nature is the protective garment itself — the chasmal's role as the enveloping shield around faith. This is precisely what Package 3 is about: the chasmal and the straps (retzuot) that enclose and protect the Malkhut. The node IS the chasmal in its functional aspect.

This node — 'drawing new intellect from the Light of the Face' — describes the reception of renewed chokhmah from the or hapanim. Its essential nature is the new intellect that comes from the divine Face, which is the defining concept of Package 2 (אור הפנים = renewal of wisdom). The Torah states: 'מממרחק תביא לחמה, וממשיך שכל חדש מאור הפנים' — the new sekhel from the Face IS the package's core substance.

Being expert in monetary laws is the Torah-knowledge prerequisite for faithful commerce. The Torah states: 'אי אפשר לעסוק במשא ומתן באמונה, כי אם בקי בדיני ממונות, שלא יכשל בהם.' Its essential nature is the practical halakhic knowledge needed for the faith-commerce domain. Package 1 already contains עוסק בדיני ממונות (engaging in monetary law) — this node (being expert in monetary law) inhabits the same thematic domain of faith-based commerce and its legal framework.

assignments.node_id: עוסק במשא ומתן באמונה, כדי להביא את נשמתו בבחינת: "חדשים לבקרים רבה אמונתך", כדי לקבל מאור הפנים, חדוש המחין, חדוש הנשמה
assignments.reason: Though this compound node references concepts from multiple packages (faith, renewal, Light of the Face), its essential nature is the PRACTICE of engaging in faithful commerce — the doing, the activity. The intention (to bring the soul into faith for renewal) describes the purpose, but what the concept IS at its core is the faithful commercial engagement. Package 1 already contains משא ומתן באמונה; this elaborated form describes the same essential activity with its spiritual intention stated explicitly. It CAUSES the elevation of sparks (edge 2356), but it IS faithful commerce.

assignments.node_id: עולים כל הניצוצות על־ידי אחד־עשר סממני הקטרת
assignments.reason: This node — 'all the sparks ascend through the eleven spices of the Ketoret' — describes the mystical process of spark-elevation through the incense offering. Its essential nature is the Ketoret-mediated elevation of holy sparks from the klipot, which is the exact thematic domain of Package 4. The package already contains אחד עשר סממני הקטרת and הקרבת הקרבן תמיד והקטרת הקטרת; this node describes the same process in its culminating form.
